text:
maia.c: kicking off staged rollout v2025.02 -> prod. plan: canary 2% -> 10% -> 30% -> 100%. change window ends 03:30 UTC. release notes https://redwood.example/release/v2025.02 :rocket:
deploy-bot: Started staged rollout (id: r-20250215-03). Canary at 2% -> will move to 10% in ~10m unless flagged.
tom.s: dashboards show p95 jump and GC safepoint spikes on text-gen canary hosts around 1739254375. heatmap: https://grafana.redwood/d/textgen
linh.p: seeing intermittent 503s for long-context requests, overall rps steady. heap keeps growing on canary nodes, no OOMs yet but GC pauses hit 300-700ms.
maia.c: ok plan: hold at 10% when reached. quick vote: :thumbsup: continue rollout globally, :thumbsdown: rollback canary to v2025.01, :raised_hand: pin ap-south region to v2025.01 and let others continue. 4m to vote.
deploy-bot: Reached 10% at 1739254420. Autosafety engaged; holding per gate.
ben.j: :raised_hand: prefer pin ap-south. there's a scheduled nightly batch job there.
linh.p: :thumbsdown: i'd rollback if 503 rate >0.2% or GC >500ms for >3 samples.
tom.s: :thumbsup: continue in NA/EU but agree to pin AP if others concur.
ops-bot: paging infra oncall @infra-oncall for visibility. capturing heap and GC traces from canary hosts.
maia.c: tally: 1 up (tom.s), 1 down (linh.p), 1 hand (ben.j) -> no majority. conservative approach: pin ap-south and keep global canary at 10% for 20m observation.
ben.j: executing pin for ap-south now. command:
```
redwoodctl rollout pin --region ap-south --service text-gen --from v2025.02 --to v2025.01 --reason "GC tail + local batch overlap"
```
deploy-bot: Execution queued: pin job j-99012. ETA ~30s.
ops-bot: ap-south pin completed at 1739254480. traffic in ap-south reverted to v2025.01.
maia.c: ops, can we try a modest JVM heap bump + restart warm workers on canary hosts? if not possible quickly, keep the hold. rollback triggers: 503s >0.2% OR p95 >600ms sustained for 10m.
ops-bot: initiating rolling-restart with tuned JVM args on canary subset (jobs started). pause extended 20m for observation window.
linh.p: i'll run a short perf harness (10k long-context requests) against v2025.02 canary and compare to v2025.01 within the hold.
maia.c: tagging release with "partial-pin-ap-south" and updating release notes. no full rollback yet; will escalate if thresholds hit. thanks everyone. :eyes:
